# Catalogue-mcp — full reference

## GitHub MCP Server

GitHub's official server (46 tools): read and write on your repos — files, commits, branches, issues, PRs, releases, code search.

- Type: remote (HTTPS)
- Endpoint/command: https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp
- Auth: OAuth / PAT
- Cost: Free
- Score: 5.0/5
- Page: https://fjjjuv.github.io/Catalogue-mcp/serveurs/github.html
- Config folder: https://github.com/fjjjuv/Catalogue-mcp/tree/main/github/

## Playwright

Full browser automation: the agent navigates, clicks, fills, extracts and screenshots real web pages.

- Type: local stdio (npx)
- Endpoint/command: npx -y @playwright/mcp@latest
- Auth: none
- Cost: Free
- Score: 4.9/5
- Page: https://fjjjuv.github.io/Catalogue-mcp/serveurs/playwright.html
- Config folder: https://github.com/fjjjuv/Catalogue-mcp/tree/main/playwright/

## Trello

Atlassian's official Trello server: the agent reads and writes your boards, lists, cards, checklists and comments.

- Type: remote (HTTPS)
- Endpoint/command: https://mcp.trello.com/v1
- Auth: OAuth 2.0
- Cost: Free
- Score: 4.8/5
- Page: https://fjjjuv.github.io/Catalogue-mcp/serveurs/trello.html
- Config folder: https://github.com/fjjjuv/Catalogue-mcp/tree/main/trello/

## Context7

Injects up-to-date library documentation into context — real versions, official examples.

- Type: local stdio (npx)
- Endpoint/command: npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp@1.0.31
- Auth: none (optional API key)
- Cost: Free
- Score: 4.7/5
- Page: https://fjjjuv.github.io/Catalogue-mcp/serveurs/context7.html
- Config folder: https://github.com/fjjjuv/Catalogue-mcp/tree/main/context7/

## DeepWiki

AI-powered docs for GitHub repos: generated wiki structure, architecture explanations, Q&A on any codebase.

- Type: remote (HTTPS)
- Endpoint/command: https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp
- Auth: none
- Cost: Free
- Score: 4.6/5
- Page: https://fjjjuv.github.io/Catalogue-mcp/serveurs/deepwiki.html
- Config folder: https://github.com/fjjjuv/Catalogue-mcp/tree/main/deepwiki/

## Asana

The official Asana MCP: access to projects, tasks, sections and comments across the workspace.

- Type: remote (HTTPS)
- Endpoint/command: https://mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp
- Auth: OAuth 2.0
- Cost: Free
- Score: 4.5/5
- Page: https://fjjjuv.github.io/Catalogue-mcp/serveurs/asana.html
- Config folder: https://github.com/fjjjuv/Catalogue-mcp/tree/main/asana/

## Semgrep

Static security analysis turned into an MCP: we hacked the `semgrep mcp` CLI command into a server.

- Type: local stdio
- Endpoint/command: semgrep mcp (local CLI → MCP server)
- Auth: none (optional login)
- Cost: Free
- Score: 4.5/5
- Page: https://fjjjuv.github.io/Catalogue-mcp/serveurs/semgrep.html
- Config folder: https://github.com/fjjjuv/Catalogue-mcp/tree/main/semgrep/

## OWASP ZAP

ZAP 2.17's official "MCP Integration" add-on: the AI drives the security scanner in natural language — spiders, active scans, alerts, reports.

- Type: local HTTP (localhost:8282)
- Endpoint/command: http://localhost:8282
- Auth: security key (Authorization header)
- Cost: Free
- Score: 4.3/5
- Page: https://fjjjuv.github.io/Catalogue-mcp/serveurs/zap.html
- Config folder: https://github.com/fjjjuv/Catalogue-mcp/tree/main/zap/

## Memory

Persistent knowledge graph: the agent remembers facts, preferences and relations across sessions.

- Type: local stdio (npx)
- Endpoint/command: npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory
- Auth: none
- Cost: Free
- Score: 4.4/5
- Page: https://fjjjuv.github.io/Catalogue-mcp/serveurs/memory.html
- Config folder: https://github.com/fjjjuv/Catalogue-mcp/tree/main/memory/

## Puppeteer

Chrome automation via the DevTools protocol: navigation, screenshots, JavaScript execution in the page.

- Type: local stdio (npx)
- Endpoint/command: npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-puppeteer
- Auth: none
- Cost: Free
- Score: 4.3/5
- Page: https://fjjjuv.github.io/Catalogue-mcp/serveurs/puppeteer.html
- Config folder: https://github.com/fjjjuv/Catalogue-mcp/tree/main/puppeteer/

## Exa Code

Code-oriented semantic web search: finds relevant examples, libraries and docs beyond keywords.

- Type: remote (HTTPS)
- Endpoint/command: https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp
- Auth: Exa API key
- Cost: Freemium
- Score: 4.2/5
- Page: https://fjjjuv.github.io/Catalogue-mcp/serveurs/exa-code.html
- Config folder: https://github.com/fjjjuv/Catalogue-mcp/tree/main/exa-code/

## Cloudflare Docs

Direct access to official Cloudflare docs: Workers, Pages, R2, DNS, security.

- Type: remote (HTTPS)
- Endpoint/command: https://docs.mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp
- Auth: none
- Cost: Free
- Score: 4.0/5
- Page: https://fjjjuv.github.io/Catalogue-mcp/serveurs/cloudflare-docs.html
- Config folder: https://github.com/fjjjuv/Catalogue-mcp/tree/main/cloudflare-docs/

## Computer Use

Real desktop control: mouse, keyboard, screenshots — the agent operates the machine like a user.

- Type: local stdio (npx)
- Endpoint/command: npx -y computer-use-mcp
- Auth: none
- Cost: Free
- Score: 3.8/5
- Page: https://fjjjuv.github.io/Catalogue-mcp/serveurs/computer-use.html
- Config folder: https://github.com/fjjjuv/Catalogue-mcp/tree/main/computer-use/

## XERJ

Rust search engine (ES-compatible) with the MCP server inside the binary: autoindex turns any folder into queryable indices, plus durable agent memory.

- Type: local stdio + local node
- Endpoint/command: xerj mcp (built into the engine binary)
- Auth: none (--insecure) or ApiKey
- Cost: Free
- Score: 4.6/5
- Page: https://fjjjuv.github.io/Catalogue-mcp/serveurs/xerj.html
- Config folder: https://github.com/fjjjuv/Catalogue-mcp/tree/main/xerj/
